ValidationRule.description: SS-11358: Validation Rule to check for any missing fields for HuntIQ ISR.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'HuntIQ_Threat_Hunter_Service_Request', OR( ISBLANK(Threat_Hunter_Justification__c), Customer_Owns_Threat_Response__c = False, Customer_Will_Provision__c = False ), ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Draft"), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
